name: Infra CI
description: Normalize Forgejo events and notify Matrix; gate production fleet releases exclusively through infra-private approval.

columns.value: ={{ { "RELEASE_RECORD_UUID": $("Decide Event Transition").item.json.RELEASE_UUID, "RELEASE_RECORD_SHA": $("Decide Event Transition").item.json.SHA, "RELEASE_RECORD_FINISHED": false, "RELEASE_RECORD_IN_PROGRESS": false } }}

parameters.jsCode:
const event = $('Decide Event Transition').first().json;
return { json: { ...event, MESSAGE_MARKDOWN: event.MESSAGE_MARKDOWN + '\n\ninfra-private Tag 构建成功，infra-private/prod 已推进；NixOS fleet 将开始更新，请观测在线设备。' } };

parameters.formDescription: 完整 fleet 构建已通过；可以准备进行 infra-private 发版。

parameters.jsCode:
const record = $json ?? {};
return { json: { ...record, APPROVAL_ALLOWED: Boolean(record.RELEASE_RECORD_UUID) && record.RELEASE_RECORD_IN_PROGRESS !== true && record.RELEASE_RECORD_FINISHED !== true } };
